campaigns.heroSubtitle: Join a campaign or create new ones
campaigns.tip: 💡 Tip: Organize your arcs and chapters so you never forget anything in your adventures

campaignCreate.title: Create a new Campaign
campaignCreate.namePlaceholder: e.g. The Shadow of the North, The Forgotten Heirs...
campaignCreate.descriptionPlaceholder: Summarize the main plot of your campaign...
campaignCreate.loreHint: Optional. If linked, you'll be able to connect arcs, chapters and scenes to Lore pages. Leave empty for a one-shot or if you'll create the Lore later.
campaignCreate.gameSystemNamePlaceholder: Name of the new system (e.g. D&D 5e, Nimble, Homebrew)
campaignCreate.gameSystemCreateHint: Quick creation — you'll be able to add rules, PC/NPC sheet templates and the rest from the "Systems" section later.
campaignCreate.gameSystemHint: Optional. If set, the AI will inject the system's rules (classes, combat, lore...) into its suggestions to respect the RPG's mechanics.
campaignCreate.gameSystemWarning: ⚠️ The chosen game system also determines the template for PC and NPC sheets. Changing it later will make the fields of existing sheets invisible (the data stays stored but will only show again when reverting to the previous system). Choose carefully from the start if possible.
campaignCreate.orgIntro: 💡 Organization: Your campaign will be structured into:

campaignDetail.loreMissingTitle: The linked universe cannot be found
campaignDetail.gameSystemNamePlaceholder: Name of the new system (e.g. D&D 5e, Nimble, Homebrew)
campaignDetail.noPlaythrough: No playthroughs. Create one to start a session with a table.

gameSystemChange.title: Change the game system?
gameSystemChange.message: You are about to change the game system of this campaign. This also changes the template for PC and NPC sheets.
gameSystemChange.detailSheets: {{n}} existing sheet(s) are linked to the current system's template.
gameSystemChange.detailFields: Their fields will no longer display with the new system.
gameSystemChange.detailStored: The data stays stored: reverting to the previous system will make them visible again.

campaignImport.title: Import a campaign PDF
campaignImport.subtitle: The AI proposes an arc → chapter → scene tree. You review and adjust it before creating anything.
campaignImport.foundSoFar: Found so far: {{arcs}} arc(s) · {{chapters}} chapter(s) · {{scenes}} scene(s) · {{npcs}} NPCs
campaignImport.errorNoStructure: No narrative structure detected in this PDF.
campaignImport.errorApply: Creation failed. Does the campaign still exist?
campaignImport.summaryToCreate: To create: {{arcs}} new arc(s), {{chapters}} chapter(s), {{scenes}} scene(s)
campaignImport.summaryHint: . Items marked "already present" (greyed out) are shown to place the additions in context; they will not be recreated. Edit the new ones, then create.
campaignImport.playerNarrationPlaceholder: Boxed text read to the players (optional)
campaignImport.npcReviewHint: Check the ones to create in the campaign (description taken from the book). Those already present in the campaign are greyed out and will not be recreated.
